# Agent skills

Personal [Agent Skills](https://agentskills.io) for GitHub Copilot, Grok, and other agents that read `SKILL.md`.

These are skills that are not part of the shared starter pack in `Scripts` / `repo-template`.

| Skill | Slash | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `wow-logs` | `/wow-logs` | Read and diagnose WoW client logs |
| `wow-locate` | `/wow-locate` | Last known in-game position (GrokLocate) |
| `reflect-decision` | `/reflect-decision` | Land a product decision in the docs |

Canonical homes elsewhere:

- `wow-locate` also ships in [GrokLocate](https://github.com/lundgren-greg/GrokLocate)
- Starter pack (`commit`, `create-pr`, `tdd`, …) lives in `C:\Repos\Scripts\.agents\skills`
